title: LLV-B125: exact source budgeting gives the quarter-leading time term

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single LLV-B125 algorithm/configuration of proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch including failures, retries, discarded copies and cap aborts, charged sequential work is O(2^((1/4)sqrt n*log2 n+3sqrt n)). The exact uniform envelope has growth index1/2 and an absolute outside constant. The finite branch n<2^4096 is explicit. Otherwise v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2 n),a=ceil(n^(1/8)),A=ceil(log2 a),m=floor((v-2a-200ell)/(2A)),kappa=ceil(log2(m+a))+3,lambda=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*(a-1))). The exact full-width and binary-finishing algorithm, all hard counters and all-modulus decoders are specified in proof.md. Every variable arity factor, source/extraction, circuit generation, addressing, reset, measurement, discarded work and abort cleanup is charged. The strict half-unit coefficient gap in Section14 absorbs the proved o(sqrt n) work term, jointly with all other claims.

For the same LLV-B125 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak classical allocation on EVERY branch is O(2^((251/1000)n^(3/8)*log2 n)) bits, with an absolute constant. The exact uniform envelope has growth index3/8. Full-label retained tables, variable-length fiber tuples, prefix lists, heaps, variable-arity loop counters, extraction scratch, caps and streamed decoder records are included. The proof bounds storage by a fixed polynomial times2^lambda, with lambda asymptotic to(1/4)n^(3/8)log2 n and eventually below(501/2000)n^(3/8)log2 n and a strict gap absorbing polynomial factors. This holds jointly with full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For the same LLV-B125 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak quantum memory on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant, including all variable-arity siblings, finishing levels, current input registers, arithmetic/rank/equality scratch and source/extraction ancillas. The exact uniform envelope n has growth index0. This holds jointly with success probability at least1-2^-8 and the other envelopes.

For the same LLV-B125 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, all fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch, including rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copies, number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)) with an absolute outside constant. The literal main hard cap nCcap+K is at most2^((1/2)sqrt n) by the exact integer depth budget, with Dbar=2^a K lambda a^m,Dcap=2^12 nDbar,Ccap=2^13 nDbar. The exact envelope has growth index1/2, jointly with full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For the same LLV-B125 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
